other.content: Over 90 papers published at major robotics conferences including: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) - 25+ papers, IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) - 28+ papers, Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) - 12 papers, ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) - 15+ papers, International Conference on Soft Robotics (RoboSoft) - 10+ papers

1. Kang, M.J., Park, J.H., & Lee, H.W. (2023). "Soft robotic gripper with embedded tactile sensors." US Patent 11,789,123; 2. Kang, M.J. & Kim, S.Y. (2022). US Patent Application 17/123,456 (pending); 4. Kang, M.J., Zhang, W., & Park, J.H. (2020). "Bio-inspired adhesive mechanism for climbing robots." US Patent 10,987,654; Korean Patent 10-2123456; 5. Korean Patent 10-1987654; 7-11. Five additional patents filed 2022-2024 (pending/confidential)

As Principal Investigator: National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) - Mid-Career Researcher Program: "Next-Generation Soft Robots for Human-Centric Applications" (2023-2028) - KRW 1,200,000,000 (~$900,000); Samsung Research Funding: "AI-Powered Collaborative Robots for Manufacturing" (2022-2025) - KRW 800,000,000 (~$600,000); Ministry of Science and ICT - Leading Research Center Program: "Center for Intelligent Soft Robotics" (2020-2027) - KRW 3,500,000,000 (~$2.6M) (Director of Center); Hyundai Motor Company: "Soft Robotic Systems for Vehicle Manufacturing" (2021-2024) - KRW 600,000,000; NRF - Global Research Laboratory Program (2018-2024) - KRW 2,000,000,000 (~$1.5M); NRF - Basic Science Research Program (2016-2021) - KRW 400,000,000; KAIST High-Risk High-Return Project (2015-2018) - KRW 300,000,000. As Co-Investigator: Multiple collaborative grants with Korean and international partners totaling ~$2M additional funding

KAIST (2011–Present): Introduction to Robotics (undergraduate, 80-100 students), Advanced Robotics (graduate, 40-50 students), Soft Robotics: Design and Control (graduate seminar, 15-20 students), Human-Robot Interaction (graduate, 25-30 students), Capstone Design Project - Robotics (undergraduate, supervise 8-10 teams annually), PhD Advanced Seminar in Robotics Research. Developed New Courses: Soft Robotics course (first in Korea, 2016), Machine Learning for Robotics (2020). Short Courses & Workshops: Tutorial Organizer, "Soft Robotics: From Design to Control" at ICRA (2022, 2019), Instructor, International Summer School on Soft Robotics (2018, 2021, 2023)

PhD Students - Graduated: 18. Recent graduates: Dr. Park Ji-Hyun (2018-2023): "Learning-based control of soft manipulators" - Now Assistant Professor at Yonsei University; Dr. Lee Hyun-Woo (2017-2022): "Tactile sensing for soft robotics" - Now Research Scientist at Samsung Research; Dr. Kim Su-Yeon (2016-2021): "Wearable soft robots for rehabilitation" - Now Postdoc at Stanford University; Dr. Chen Yu (2015-2020): "Bio-inspired climbing robots" - Now Assistant Professor at Tsinghua University; Dr. Zhang Wei (2014-2019): "Origami robotics" - Now Senior Researcher at ETH Zurich. PhD Students - Current: 8. MS Students: Supervised 34 MS students (2011-Present). Postdoctoral Researchers - Current: 4 (Dr. Tanaka Yuki, Dr. Sarah Johnson, Dr. Ahmed Hassan, Dr. Maria Santos). Undergraduate Researchers: Mentored 40+ undergraduate research projects

Editorial Boards: Associate Editor, IEEE Transactions on Robotics (2021-Present), Associate Editor, Soft Robotics (2019-Present), Editorial Board Member, International Journal of Robotics Research (2020-Present), Guest Editor, Special Issue on "Soft Robotics" - IEEE Robotics & Automation Magazine (2022). Conference Organization: Program Chair, IEEE International Conference on Soft Robotics (RoboSoft) 2025, Area Chair, IEEE ICRA (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024), Area Chair, IEEE/RSJ IROS (2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024), Co-organizer, RSS Workshop on Soft Robotics (2019, 2021, 2023), General Chair, Korean Robotics Society Annual Conference (2023). Professional Leadership: Vice President, Korean Robotics Society (2022-2024), Member, IEEE RAS Technical Committee on Soft Robotics (2017-Present), Member, IEEE RAS Technical Committee on Human-Robot Interaction (2015-Present). Peer Review: Active reviewer for 30+ journals and conferences including Science Robotics, Nature Communications, IEEE Transactions (Robotics, Automation Science & Engineering), International Journal of Robotics Research, and all major robotics conferences. 200+ reviews completed.

Over 60 invited talks at universities and research institutions worldwide (2011-2024). Recent keynotes: Keynote Speaker, International Conference on Soft Robotics (2024), Plenary Talk, IEEE/RSJ IROS (2023), Keynote, Asian Conference on Robotics and Automation (2022), Distinguished Lecture, IEEE Robotics & Automation Society (2021), Invited seminars at: MIT, Stanford, CMU, UC Berkeley, ETH Zurich, Max Planck Institute, University of Tokyo, National University of Singapore (2019-2024)

Co-founder and Technical Advisor, SoftRobot Inc. (startup commercializing soft gripper technology) - 2020; Technology licensing agreements with Samsung, Hyundai, and LG for robotic technologies developed in lab; Consultant for multiple robotics companies in Korea and internationally

Research Interests: Actuator and sensor design for soft robots

personalInfo.personalStatement: Internationally recognized robotics researcher with expertise in human-robot interaction, soft robotics, and bio-inspired robotic systems. Over 15 years of research experience with 110+ peer-reviewed publications in top-tier venues including Science Robotics, IEEE Transactions, and major robotics conferences. Multiple best paper awards and patents for novel robotic mechanisms and control algorithms. Strong track record of translating fundamental research into practical applications with several successful technology transfers to industry. Committed to advancing robotics education and fostering next generation of robotics researchers.
